---
title: "Events"
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source(file.path(Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR", "."), "R", "site.R"))
ev <- site_events()
```

Where to find me in person. If you'll be at one of these, come say hi.

```{r}
#| results: asis
soon <- upcoming_events(events = ev)
if (length(soon)) {
  cat("## Upcoming\n\n")
  for (e in soon) cat("- ", event_line(e), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("\n")
}
```

## Regulars

```{r}
#| results: asis
for (e in ev$regulars) cat("- ", event_line(e), "\n", sep = "")
```

## Past

```{r}
#| results: asis
for (block in past_events(events = ev)) {
  cat("### ", block$year, "\n\n", sep = "")
  for (e in block$items) cat("- ", event_line(e, past = TRUE), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("\n")
}
```
